reason: 该仓库的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的 AI 角色库插件：仓库包含大量角色目录、角色列表与入口文件，README 说明安装后模型在会话中可见角色目录并按需通过 skill 工具加载对应角色。其能力集中在会话提示词/角色加载，而非代码生成、测试执行或外部服务集成。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可插拔的 AI 专家角色库，安装后可在对话中按需加载并切换不同角色协助任务处理。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a plug-and-play AI role library for DeepSeek Harness, enabling conversation-based loading of different roles on demand to assist with tasks.

capabilities: Provides an extensive AI role catalog for model session use.
Loads role prompt definitions on demand through DeepSeek Harness skill invocation.
Supports explicit role invocation patterns such as role-id based commands in user input.

reasons.code: Repository README and metadata describe a DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes a role catalog and loads role definitions through the skill tool for conversation use.
Package manifest includes DSH bundle configuration and plugin entrypoints (index.js/types) indicating runtime integration with the host platform.
Repository tree contains numerous role-domain directories and catalog/list files (e.g., AGENT-LIST, CATALOG), consistent with a prompt-library plugin rather than executable tooling.
